en.headline: Customs arrest two Opatra London managers over alleged aggressive sales
en.dek: A man and a woman described as financial and administration managers were detained on Wednesday after six complaints of high-pressure tactics involving sums of up to HK$100,000.
body: Hong Kong Customs arrested two managers linked to the local operations of beauty chain Opatra London on Wednesday on suspicion of using aggressive commercial practices, according to reports and sources familiar with the case.

The pair, described as a financial manager and an administration manager, were detained after the department received at least six complaints, mostly from middle-aged or elderly customers. The alleged losses ranged from HK$1,800 to HK$100,000. One widely reported case involved a 58-year-old woman who said she spent about HK$61,400 at a Sha Tin branch.

Customs officers had earlier searched the company’s registered principal place of business in Sheung Wan and found only a corporate secretarial firm at the address. Four outlets in Sha Tin, Yuen Long and Causeway Bay had suspended operations. The department said the investigation under the Trade Descriptions Ordinance was continuing and that further enforcement action would be taken if evidence of offences was found.
Opatra London’s UK headquarters has stated that the Hong Kong shops are operated by a local distribution partner and that it takes the matter seriously and is cooperating with authorities.

zh.headline: 海關拘Opatra London兩名經理 涉不良營商手法
zh.dek: 海關周三拘捕一男一女管理人員，涉使用具威嚇性的營業行為，接獲至少六宗投訴，涉款由1,800元至10萬元不等。
body: 香港海關周三拘捕兩名與美容連鎖店Opatra London本地業務有關的管理人員，一名為財務經理、一名為行政經理，涉嫌使用具威嚇性的營業行為，違反《商品說明條例》。
海關至今接獲至少六宗投訴，受害人多為中年人或長者，涉款由1,800元至10萬元不等。其中一宗廣為報道的個案，一名58歲女子指在沙田新城市廣場分店被壓迫消費約61,400元。
海關早前搜查該公司在上環註冊的「首要營運地址」，發現只是一間秘書公司，並無實際營業活動或員工。沙田、元朗及銅鑼灣共四間分店已暫停營業。海關表示調查仍在進行，若有足夠證據會採取進一步執法行動。
Opatra London英國總部表示，本港店鋪由本地分銷商營運，集團十分重視事件，並會全力配合香港當局調查。
